This cozy pullover features a limited-edition LA-inspired print with a sunset heart, palm trees, LA lettering, and LoveShackFancy printed beneath. The sweatshirt features a ribbed collar and ribbed sleeve cuffs. Slightly oversized fit About Altadena Girls Altadena Girls is a youth-led movement rooted in community care and empowerment. What began as a grassroots effort by 8th-grader Avery Colvert to support girls affected by the Eaton Canyon Fire has grown into a national response fueled by local love. We’re focused on restoring dignity, confidence, and connection for girls who’ve experienced loss, instability, or emotional hardship. With the help of volunteers, public figures, and partner brands, Altadena Girls is creating sustainable support systems that center young voices and meet real needs with compassion and care. www. altadenagirls. org | LA Pullover for Women in Pink Sunset
